ceo.photo_alt: Antoninus Hines, Founder of the AH Foundation and CEO of Integrity National Corporation
ceo.quote: Through collaboration, resources, and faith in action, the AH Foundation and its partners were able to meet people where they are and make a meaningful impact in the community. May the work continue, the impact multiply, and the communities served be strengthened.
